scope: Precise, answer-level calibrations on recent original 8 Chemistry v199 and 10 AS Physics v200 school-mock questions. No new cards or questions.
method: Test concise valid student phrasings against real examSuggested(), compare awarded counts to visibly indicated mark points, check negation/incorrect numeric values and exact unit errors. Add 44 vetted accepted aliases across six questions with per-point coverage and three explicit unit-confusion rejects. Keep all original marking schemes and support manual marking adjustment.
